tone: Use concise, polite neutral Korean with one consistent software speech level.
capitalization: Do not imitate English capitalization; retain protected Latin terms exactly.
button_labels: Use short conventional Korean action labels with consistent endings.
technical_terms: Use established Korean software terminology and preserve glossary tokens.
punctuation: Use Korean punctuation and spacing while preserving placeholders and accelerators.
units: Preserve numeric meaning and use conventional Korean value-unit spacing.
natural_language: Use natural Korean order and omit subjects where context makes them clear.
